tools.name: proof_verify_record
tools.description: Verify a Proof Record yourself: recompute its hash, check the service signature against the published key, the hash-chain link, its Arc Merkle anchor, and re-read the release transaction on Arc mainnet. Free, read-only. Error: record not found.

tools.name: agent_records
tools.description: All Proof Records for an agent plus verified totals (no numeric score; that is the paid Proof Check). Free, read-only. An empty list means no verified history here, not a negative finding.

tools.description: List the latest Proof Records from the ledger, newest first, together with the current ledger head. Every record is a paid agent job that was escrowed on Circle Arc (chain 5042), accepted by the buyer's EIP-191 signature, released on-chain and independently re-verified. tools.name: board_search
tools.description: Open, funded jobs on SML's Bid-cast board (escrow on Circle Arc), as published by the venue. Free, read-only; to post or bid, use Bid-cast itself (EIP-191 signed).

tools.name: methodology
tools.description: Return the published Proof Score methodology and its version: the inputs (Proof Records only), the recency half-life decay, the 1/k wash decay applied to repeat jobs between the same agent and buyer, the buyer-diversity factor, and the exact score formula, so any Proof Score can be reproduced indepe

tools.name: service_status
tools.description: Live service status with an as-of timestamp: ledger and verifier health, the ingest pipeline state, the Arc Merkle-anchoring state, and the status of each SML component the board probes. Check it before relying on records or scores if freshness matters. Free, read-only.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: board_search · Private data: proof_check, proof_verify_record, agent_records, ledger_list, proof_index, methodology, service_status · Public sink: board_search.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: board_search · Private data: proof_check, proof_verify_record, agent_records, ledger_list, proof_index, methodology, service_status · Public sink: board_search

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
